title: 她很像一个人
slug: 豪门情变前夫过期不候全本免费-豪门情变前夫过期不候最新章节列表
content_zh:
唯一的反应就是‘逃走’，她不能亲眼看着他和别的女人调情，这样……她至少还可以对自己说……所有的报道只是流言！
她踉跄着转身，想赶快逃离那个地方……凌乱的步伐忽然顿住，她想起还要提醒他小心顾天承，虽然她并不清楚他们之间发生了什么事，谁对谁错，她只是单纯担心他！
深呼吸，她告诉自己，这就是爱他的代价，她必须面对！
“顾少最坏了……”女人的娇吟越来越媚。
她僵硬着扭开病房门，房间弥漫的浓重暧昧杀得她措手不及，这一刻她才知道自己有多脆弱，手指一点一点收紧，任那玻璃心碎了一地又一地。
顾少卿淡淡扫了她一眼，眼底波澜不惊，“你来干什么？”
他怀里的女人似乎认出她，浅笑妖娆，漂亮的眼睛里分明的挑衅和敌意。
心语也认出她，顾氏新签的绝色代言人，之前没留心看，原来真人竟比电视上还要漂亮，眉如远黛，口若樱桃，颇有些楚楚动人的韵味，更重要的是，她眉眼间很像一个人，一个……他爱了很多年的女人！
她没看顾少卿，迎视美女的挑衅，一脸淡然，眼带笑意，“这位小姐可以请你先出去吗，我想跟我丈夫单独谈谈！”
顾少卿眸底流露出淡渺的玩味，看着她带笑的眼睛渐渐泛出水光，知道她快撑到极限了。
“Charlene（莎琳）”他拍拍美女示意她出去。
美女故意撒娇着起身，从心语身边走过时，脸上得意的笑刺痛了她的眼睛。
“什么事，说吧？”他言语中尽是不耐。
心语眨眼，眼中有晶莹一闪，泪终究是没落下来，“你出事跟大哥有关？大哥给你的是什么？”
顾少卿眼中一凛，“我的事你最好少管！还有，大哥来找我的事，不准跟任何人提起！”
“你和他……？”
“出去！”冷厉的声音没有一丝温度。
心语不知道自己是怎么走出病房的，她出来时，天阴沉沉的，盈眶的泪忽然就掉了下来，她也忘了擦，只是没有方向地沿着街道缓缓向前走，脖颈处渐渐有冰冰凉意，她抱紧双臂……
蓦地，不知是从哪里窜出的记者围住她。
“顾太太，有人看到顾氏新签的美女代言人在医院出现，她是和顾先生一起吗？”

“顾太太是来抓奸的吗？”
…………
心语在人群中瑟瑟发抖，她颤抖着摸出手机按下顾少卿的电话号码，原来不管他对她多残忍，她遇到困难第一时间想的只有他……

content_en:
The only reaction was to 'run away'. She couldn't watch him flirting with other women, so...she could at least say to herself...all the reports were just rumors!
She turned around staggeringly, trying to escape from that place quickly... Her messy steps suddenly stopped, and she remembered that she wanted to remind him to be careful about Gu Tiancheng. Although she didn't know what happened between them, who was right and who was wrong, she was just worried about him!
Taking a deep breath, she told herself that this was the price of loving him, and she had to face it!
"Young Master Gu is the worst..." The woman's moans became more and more charming.
She stiffly opened the door to the ward, and the heavy ambiguity that filled the room caught her off guard. Only at this moment did she realize how fragile she was. She tightened her fingers bit by bit, letting the glass heart break again and again.
Gu Shaoqing glanced at her lightly, his eyes calm, "What are you doing here?"
The woman in his arms seemed to recognize her, with a enchanting smile and clear provocation and hostility in her beautiful eyes.
Xinyu also recognized her, Gu's newly signed stunning spokesperson. She hadn't paid attention to it before, but it turned out that she was even more beautiful in real life than on TV. Her eyebrows were as dark as white, and her mouth was as cherry as a cherry. She had a charming charm. More importantly, her eyebrows looked very much like the same person, a... woman he had loved for many years!
She did not look at Gu Shaoqing and faced the beauty's provocation with a calm expression and a smile in her eyes. "Miss, can you please go out first? I want to talk to my husband alone!"
There was a hint of amusement in Gu Shaoqing's eyes. Seeing her smiling eyes gradually becoming watery, he knew that she was almost reaching her limit.
"Charlene (Charlene)" He patted the beauty and signaled her to go out.
The beauty deliberately stood up coquettishly, and when she walked past Xinyu, the proud smile on her face stung her eyes.
"What's the matter? Tell me?" His words were full of impatience.
Xinyu blinked, and there was a glint in her eyes. After all, the tears did not fall, "Is your accident related to big brother? What did big brother give you?"
Gu Shaoqing's eyes flashed, "You'd better stay out of my business! Also, don't mention the matter of eldest brother's visit to me to anyone!"
"You and him...?"
"Get out!" The cold voice had no warmth at all.
Xinyu didn't know how she got out of the ward. When she came out, the sky was overcast, and tears suddenly fell from her eyes. She forgot to wipe them, but walked slowly along the street without direction. An icy chill gradually felt on her neck. She crossed her arms...
Suddenly, reporters appeared from nowhere and surrounded her.
"Mrs. Gu, someone saw Gu's newly signed beauty spokesperson appear in the hospital. Is she with Mr. Gu?"
"Is Mrs. Gu here to catch someone raping?"
…………
Xinyu trembled in the crowd. She tremblingly took out her mobile phone and pressed Gu Shaoqing's phone number. It turned out that no matter how cruel he was to her, the first thing she thought of was him when she encountered difficulties...
